assessments.fundamentals: [fs] Direct issuer 62-page consolidated H1 accounts: limited review with negative assurance, not an annual audit. June assets EGP 277,949,321,631 equal liabilities 231,071,055,504 plus total equity 46,878,266,127 exactly. Owners equity is 46,658,459,400 and NCI 219,806,727. H1 total profit 10,781,423,226 splits owners 10,760,405,784 plus NCI 21,017,442. CFO 13,494,414,055, investing -48,643,404,542 and financing -6,322,895,127 reconcile cash from 59,260,993,478 to 17,789,107,864 with zero residual. Treasury investment deployment is a bank balance-sheet allocation, not generic industrial free cash flow or proof of distress. [release] Standalone H1 profit is EGP 9.924 billion, NIM 15.3% versus 17.2%, impairment EGP 776 million versus 318 million, administrative costs EGP 2.824 billion versus 2.282 billion, CAR 41.7%, NPL 4.2%, coverage 173.2%. Keep these scopes separate. Growing loans and capital are bullish; margin and credit-cost pressure challenge sustainable ROE. [fs] Note 34 states EGP 10.626 billion capital, 1.0626 billion shares at EGP 10 par, one-for-one bonus approved March 25, 2025 and registered June 15, 2026. Its unlabelled owner table NUCA 158,395,608 at 29.81% uses an older 531.3 million denominator; it does not verify current post-bonus quantities. This is a continuity/roll-forward gap, not an allegation of misstatement. Provider PE 5.1515 versus 6 peers at median 4.4306, PB 2.197 versus 7 at 0.9446 and ROE 49.66% versus 6 at 31.60% require sustainable bank returns and matching periods; they do not establish cheapness. No sourced forward ROE/payout/cost-of-equity scenarios or current book roll-forward support a residual-income fair value.

thesis.whyThisStock: Normal reassessment of the preserved original Wait after a newly confirmed support failure, with substantive primary document recovery.
thesis.whyNow: October18 confirmed price crossed the original review condition; source recovery permits a deeper challenge of the original economics, not a retrospective trade.
thesis.mispricingMechanism: A potential rerating requires proof that durable cash/earnings and capital quality outweigh uncertainty. No mispricing magnitude or probability is established.
thesis.bullCase: Large capital buffer, profit growth and loan expansion support a banking franchise thesis.
thesis.bearCase: Margin compression, sharply rising credit charges and failed support challenge immediate continuation; current owner/ex-date chain remains unresolved.
thesis.alternativeExplanation: Earlier gains may have reflected speculation, expected future results or liquidity, rather than recurring cash generation; the later fall may reflect broad market risk, not a company event.
thesis.pricedIn: Prior appreciation and subsequent correction show expectations changed, but no verified consensus or event-study isolates how much fundamental news is priced.
thesis.invalidation: Preserve original failed support evidence. Verified adverse capital, reserve, credit, funding or legal facts can defeat a recovery thesis. No execution stop is approved.
thesis.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Close the explicit company/action gaps, obtain a confirmed new reversal and suitable liquidity, then validate the complete cost-stressed priced plan independently.
thesis.whyBetterThanAlternative: No superiority over COMI is established. It is a distinct opportunity-cost comparator, requiring its own complete sector-aware assessment.
thesis.disagreementResolution: Improved primary facts reduce uncertainty but do not offset failed timing or remaining action/quality gaps. Defer despite mechanically attractive lower-zone diagnostic geometry.
thesis.evidenceQuality: Direct issuer accounts for HDB; actual signed primary scans with explicit mirror custody for MOIN/AMIA, corroborating official notices and arithmetic. Missing evidence stays explicit.
thesis.uncertainties: Residual income needs supported sustainable ROE, payout and cost-of-equity cases; period ROE and old book cannot simply become a current fair value. No three sourced forward scenarios, calibrated probability, full portfolio or real sizing.
thesis.status: Analytical research; final guarded approval remains separate
